description: Step 4 of docs/the-delivery-loop.md: a branch published as a checkpoint. The mandate is one JSON object naming the repo, the branch, the title and the three sections of the text (problem, behaviour, verification), with base and forge_repo optional, and either the issue it closes or the reason there is none. An unsaid base is the trunk the repository declares. The branch head is recorded first and every later step refuses if it moved. The text is written to a file in the first person under the headings Problem, Behaviour and Verification, and refused if it names a model, a session or a tool signature, or quotes anyone. The delivery policy is read from the trusted trunk; `ask` hands the push to a person. A branch rebased since its last checkpoint is pushed with a lease on the ref just read, so a branch that moved under it is refused rather than overwritten. The publication gate runs on the commits before the push and on the text before the pull request, and the private-names check is posted from here, because only this machine holds the list. The run is complete only when the remote branch carries the recorded commit and an open draft pull request reads that same head. Every forge call runs as the account the tree declares in sailor.forgeAs, and the step refuses when none is declared.

with.command:
set -eu
common=$(cd "$REPO" && cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" && pwd)
outgoing="$common/sailor/outgoing"
mkdir -p "$outgoing"
file="$outgoing/pull-request-$(printf '%s' "$BRANCH" | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16).md"
FILE="$file" python3 -c '
import json, os, re, sys
problem = os.environ["PROBLEM"].strip()
if os.environ["ISSUE"]:
    problem += "\n\nCloses #%s." % os.environ["ISSUE"]
else:
    problem += "\n\nNo issue: %s" % os.environ["NO_ISSUE"].strip()
sections = [("Problem", problem), ("Behaviour", os.environ["BEHAVIOUR"]), ("Verification", os.environ["VERIFICATION"])]
for heading, text in sections:
    if not text.strip():
        sys.exit("the %s section is empty" % heading)
body = "\n\n".join("## %s\n\n%s" % (heading, text.strip()) for heading, text in sections) + "\n"
whole = os.environ["TITLE"] + "\n" + body
if not re.search(r"\b(I|I am|I have|my|me)\b", body):
    sys.exit("the pull request text is not written in the first person")
named = re.search(r"(?i)\b(claude|codex|gemini|gpt(-?[0-9o]+)?|chatgpt|o[134](-mini)?|opus|sonnet|haiku|fable|anthropic|openai|copilot|cursor|windsurf|aider|cline|devin|llama|mistral|mixtral|grok|deepseek|qwen|phi-?[0-9]|bard|palm|llm|language models?|co-authored-by|generated with|session id|session_id|claude-session)\b", whole)
if named:
    sys.exit("the pull request text names a model, a session or a tool signature: " + named.group(0))
machine = r"(an?\s+|the\s+|my\s+)?(ai|a\.i\.|artificial intelligence|coding|automated|language)?\s*(agents?|assistants?|bots?|models?|llms?|ai|a\.i\.)\b"
credited = (re.search(r"(?i)\b(written|generated|created|produced|drafted|authored|made|done|coded|implemented|assisted|helped|built|reviewed)\s+(by|with|using|via|through)\s+" + machine, whole)
            or re.search(r"(?i)\bwith\s+(the\s+)?(help|assistance|aid|support)\s+of\s+" + machine, whole)
            or re.search(r"(?i)\b(an?\s+)?(ai|a\.i\.)\s+(agents?|assistants?|models?|tools?)\b|\bcoding\s+(agents?|assistants?)\b", whole))
if credited:
    sys.exit("the pull request text credits the work to an agent, an assistant or a model: " + credited.group(0).strip())
if re.search(r"(?m)^\s*>", body):
    sys.exit("the pull request text quotes someone: a blockquote is not how this text speaks")
if re.search(r"```|~~~|^( {4}|\t)\S", body, re.M):
    sys.exit("the pull request text carries a code block, which is where a quoted prompt hides")
if re.search(r"\"[^\"\n]+\"|\u201c[^\u201d\n]+\u201d|\u00ab[^\u00bb\n]+\u00bb", whole) or re.search(r"(?i)\bprompt(ed|s)?\b", whole):
    sys.exit("the pull request text quotes someone or names a prompt")
title = os.environ["TITLE"].strip()
if not title or "\n" in title:
    sys.exit("the title is empty or spans more than one line")
with open(os.environ["FILE"], "w") as out:
    out.write(title + "\n\n" + body)
print(json.dumps({"body_file": os.environ["FILE"]}))
'

$join: The delivery policy read from the trusted trunk (commit
) asks a person before this flow may push the branch and open or update its draft pull request. Approve with an output file holding {"authorized": true}, or reject with the reason.

options.label: authorize
options.facts: every check before this step passed on the recorded commit

options.label: refuse
options.facts: nothing outward has happened yet; the run stops here

with.command:
set -eu
# The list of private names lives only on this machine, so the forge cannot post
# this check for itself. Until it is posted the request stays blocked and the
# host says nothing about why.
cd "$REPO"
git -C "$REPO" fetch -q --no-tags "$REMOTE_NAME"
"$REPO/scripts/attest-private-names.sh" "$COMMIT" >&2
printf '{"attested":"%s","posted":true}' "$COMMIT"

set -eu
cd "$REPO"
# An inherited GH_REPO would point a call at another repository: it goes before the first gh call.
unset GH_REPO
forge_as=$(git -C "$REPO" config --get sailor.forgeAs) || { echo "sailor.forgeAs is not declared on this tree: refusing to act as the machine's active account" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -n "$forge_as" ] || { echo "sailor.forgeAs is empty on this tree: refusing to act as the machine's active account" >&2; exit 1; }
env -u GH_TOKEN -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_REPO gh auth token --user "$forge_as" >/dev/null || { echo "no forge token for the declared account $forge_as" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -z "${FORGE_REPO:-}" ] || export GH_REPO="$FORGE_REPO"
# An empty --user or an empty GH_TOKEN makes gh answer as the machine's active account.
forge() {
    who=$(git -C "$REPO" config --get sailor.forgeAs) && [ -n "$who" ] || { echo "sailor.forgeAs vanished from this tree: refusing" >&2; exit 1; }
    token=$(env -u GH_TOKEN -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_REPO gh auth token --user "$who") && [ -n "$token" ] || { echo "no forge token for $who: refusing" >&2; exit 1; }
    if [ -n "${FORGE_REPO:-}" ]; then
        env -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN -u GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN GH_REPO="$FORGE_REPO" GH_TOKEN="$token" gh "$@"
    else
        env -u GITHUB_TOKEN -u GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN -u GITHUB_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN -u GH_REPO GH_TOKEN="$token" gh "$@"
    fi
}
text_now=$(shasum -a 256 < "$TEXT_FILE") || { echo "cannot read $TEXT_FILE to compare it with what the gate judged" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "${text_now%% *}" = "$TEXT_SHA" ] || { echo "$TEXT_FILE changed after the publication gate judged it: nothing leaves" >&2; exit 1; }
TITLE=$(head -n 1 "$TEXT_FILE")
BODY_FILE="$TEXT_FILE.body"
tail -n +3 "$TEXT_FILE" > "$BODY_FILE"
number=$(forge pr list --head "$BRANCH" --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
if [ -z "$number" ]; then
    forge pr create --draft --base "$BASE" --head "$BRANCH" --title "$TITLE" --body-file "$BODY_FILE" >&2
else
    forge pr edit "$number" --title "$TITLE" --body-file "$BODY_FILE" >&2
fi
tries=0
while :; do
    seen=$(forge pr view "$BRANCH" --json number,url,isDraft,headRefOid,state --jq '[.number, .url, .isDraft, .headRefOid, .state] | @tsv') || seen=""
    number=$(printf '%s' "$seen" | cut -f1); url=$(printf '%s' "$seen" | cut -f2); draft=$(printf '%s' "$seen" | cut -f3)
    oid=$(printf '%s' "$seen" | cut -f4); state=$(printf '%s' "$seen" | cut -f5)
    [ "$oid" = "$HEAD_COMMIT" ] && break
    tries=$((tries + 1))
    [ "$tries" -lt 10 ] || { echo "the pull request for $BRANCH reads head $oid, not $HEAD_COMMIT" >&2; exit 1; }
    sleep 3
done
[ "$state" = OPEN ] || { echo "the pull request for $BRANCH is $state, not OPEN" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '{"number":%s,"url":"%s","draft":%s,"head":"%s"}' "$number" "$url" "$draft" "$oid"
